arStrings.szText: The eclipse is coming! Hope is coming in these times of strife!
Hold close your brethren and stay steadfast against the hard-hearted skeptics of this strange, unwelcome country!
You have crossed seas to be with Akarat! Left behind homes, families, livelihoods, all to be with Akarat!
And these casters of judgment would stop you now? Here, on the threshold of the new age our prophet promised?
We bring peace to Sanctuary. Do not let them bar you from what you know to be good and right!
We are one! Never let them tear us apart!
